verdict.rationale: Kick's docs confirm the default chart of accounts can be customized by adding, renaming, or restructuring accounts, and the Plus plan lists "classes" as a feature. Account types and sub-account hierarchy are not explicitly documented, and classes appear only as a line in the pricing table with no description of how they work as a dimension. missing for 10: explicit documentation of account types, sub-account/parent-child hierarchy, class or tag dimension behavior and reporting, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions

citations.quote: Kick sets up a standard Chart of Accounts when you create your workspace, and you or your accountant can adjust it from there: adding, renaming, or restructuring accounts as needed
Plus — $100/mo — Unlimited entities, classes, accrual ledger, AR & AP
